title: Artificial Intelligence
overview: An interdisciplinary minor examining AI through humanities and governance, with AI Studies and AI Governance tracks.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence
sources.locator: Interdisciplinary minor; two tracks of study

outcomes.text: Evaluate AI’s social and ethical effects and develop approaches for responsible governance.

requirements.title: Core and ethics
requirements.summary: A core course and one ethics course are required. The fetched catalog renders their references as opaque IDs, so the finite course choices remain unresolved.

requirements.title: Choose one track
requirements.summary: Choose AI Studies or AI Governance.

requirements.title: AI Studies
requirements.summary: Two approved humanities AI electives, an AI-related internship and the Krebs Humanities Scholar Experience.

requirements.title: AI Governance
requirements.summary: One approved statistics course; one humanities AI elective; a second elective from the humanities AI pool or the approved technical pool; and the capstone. PSYC 222 requires PSYC 221.

requirements.title: Elective overlap
requirements.summary: PHIL 222 and PHIL 283 can count as electives only when not used for ethics.

notes: The official overview and requirement body establish a minor. The catalog template also displays Bachelor’s Degree/Bachelor of Arts; that inconsistent template label is not promoted to a separate degree.
Catalog course references render as opaque IDs rather than resolved course codes. Finite core, ethics, statistics and elective lists remain unresolved; curriculum partial.
Catalog year, institutional minor policies, individual course metadata and launch date are unverified.
